speaker: alse_pinder
text: The basin is where I said, at the turn. The water is cold. I did not heat it. A playhouse is not a guest's hands.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Cold is a fit. Thank you. I am not carrying a crumb into the coat Edith stitched.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: She stitched you? Then come back with the stitch still in. I am not a mender, and Mistress will not have a torn shoulder blamed on her loaf.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The stitch is a shrug, she said, and it is not on the book. I will try to keep it dull enough to survive a yard.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Two o'clock is an hour, near enough, and the road is the same both ways. I will not walk you to the gate. I have the board to scrape, and the notch to ignore.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Ignore it. It has been a true notch all year. I will be out of the house at the hour, and I will not come back in the middle of a play to prove I remember the broth.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The broth can survive without a witness. Go. Your cloak is by the street door. Gib is off the stair, which is the only courtesy he means to show you today.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will take the courtesy. If I am late, it will be the road, not a speech on the landing.
